judgeProtocol.answers: A | B | same - one word per question, then one sentence naming what in the picture decided it
judgeProtocol.blind: the judge is not told which screenshot is ours; product names and logos are not masked (unproven whether they should be)
judgeProtocol.inputs: the two screenshots and the two metric blocks (E1-E12, style)
judgeProtocol.pairing: ours against one reference, same screen, same state, same viewport
judgeProtocol.runs: 3 per pair with the order swapped; a verdict counts at 3/3, else `split`

E5.desktop: ids allowed only inside [data-id]; JSON allowed only inside a code block; =0 for dotted keys and untranslated snake_case labels
E5.phone: n/a (Developer view is absent on the phone)
E5.reason: ia-reset C6: Developer view is where the machine may show

E5.desktop: =0 for JSON, dotted keys and snake_case; ids allowed only inside [data-id]
E5.reason: ia-reset section E, E5 console rule

ref.all: limits are not gates for a reference product: the numbers are recorded and compared, never failed

empty.E3: =1 on Home, Rooms, Meetings, Tasks and on every empty state that can create (ia-reset E3)
empty.E9: =1: exactly one empty state, with what is empty, the next action and the benefit (standard section 6)

error.E11: =0: an error names what failed and offers one way on (retry, go back, ask for help); a bare 'Something went wrong' is a wall
error.E5: =0: no status code, stack or key in the message

loading-skeleton.E9: not measured (skeleton blocks are not empty boxes)
loading-skeleton.note: only layout stability is compared: the skeleton's regions must match the populated regions within 8 px (proposed, unproven)

long.E6: =0 is the point of this state: long names, long lists and long messages must not clip or push the layout sideways
long.E7: unchanged: more data must not push content down

colour.hexValues: not fixed here: read from the token file by the probe (unproven where the DTCG file lives); the targets are counts
colour.rule: structure carries hierarchy, not colour (standard 13 rule 2): neutrals for text, surface and border; ONE accent; state colours (danger, warning, success) only on state

styleSystem.distinctSizesNote: the standard's scale has 7 steps while the lanes file says '<= 6 type sizes': the per-archetype caps below are <= 5, the system union <= 7 - the founder or the orchestrator settles 6 against 7
styleSystem.radiusNote: a fully round avatar or pill (9999px / 50%) is allowed and not counted as a radius step
styleSystem.source: docs/design/13-massrelay-design-standard.md line 99 (type scale), line 253 (spacing 4-pt, radii 4/8/12, shadows none in light / one elevation step), lines 311-312 (8 between controls, 16 between groups, 24/32 between sections); the three system caps come from CMP-UI-1-lanes.md ('<= 6 type sizes, <= 12 colours, >= 0.95 on the 4px scale'). docs/STATUS.md lists the standard as unreviewed.
